As Open Text Com (OTEX) Shares Rose, Disciplined Growth Investors Lowered by $1.84 Million Its Stake; Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Holder Iconiq Capital Decreased Its Stake by $2.71 Million as Market Valuation Rose
May 27, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Iconiq Capital Llc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 2.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Iconiq Capital Llc sold 15,767 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 620,570 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $107.01 million, down from 636,337 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Iconiq Capital Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $511.84 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.83 during the last trading session, reaching $199.2. About 21.27M shares traded or 20.67% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Disciplined Growth Investors Inc decreased its stake in Open Text Corp Com (OTEX) by 0.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Disciplined Growth Investors Inc sold 52,599 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.97% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 5.69M shares of the edp services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $202.88M, down from 5.74 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Disciplined Growth Investors Inc who had been investing in Open Text Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.29 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $34.73. About 317,081 shares traded. Open Text Corporation (NASDAQ:OTEX) has risen 0.38% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.17% the S&P500.
Among 39 analysts covering Alibaba ( NYSE:BABA ), 37 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 95% are positive. Alibaba had 179 analyst reports since August 12, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Standpoint Research upgraded the shares of BABA in report on Thursday, January 21 to “Buy” rating. Oppenheimer maintained Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) on Monday, June 26 with “Buy” rating. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, January 25 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. The firm has “Buy” rating by Needham given on Tuesday, May 9. Bank of America maintained the shares of BABA in report on Monday, May 7 with “Buy” rating. Barclays Capital maintained Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) rating on Wednesday, August 2. Barclays Capital has “Overweight” rating and $180 target. The rating was maintained by Brean Capital with “Buy” on Friday, January 29. On Friday, August 12 the stock rating was upgraded by Raymond James to “Strong Buy”. Jefferies maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, February 2 report. The stock of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) earned “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Monday, August 14.
More notable recent Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) news were published by: Fool.com which released: “6 Unusual Things You Probably Didn’t Know About Alibaba” on May 26, 2018, also Finance.Yahoo.com with their article: “Why You Should Buy Alibaba (BABA) Stock” published on May 11, 2018, Seekingalpha.com published: “3 Option Trade Ideas In Alibaba Stock” on May 24, 2018. More interesting news about Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) were released by: Schaeffersresearch.com and their article: “Analyst Sees 52% Upside for Alibaba Stock” published on May 24, 2018 as well as Livetradingnews.com ‘s news article titled: “Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) Heffx Technical Analysis” with publication date: May 18, 2018.
Iconiq Capital Llc, which manages about $7.58B and $969.52 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Vanguard Index Fds (VTI) by 11,006 shares to 114,905 shares, valued at $15.77 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (ACWI) by 43,219 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.42 million shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) to report earnings on August, 16. They expect $1.16 earnings per share, up 23.40% or $0.22 from last year’s $0.94 per share. BABA’s profit will be $2.98 billion for 42.93 P/E if the $1.16 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.54 actual earnings per share reported by Alibaba Group Holding Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 114.81% EPS growth.

Disciplined Growth Investors Inc, which manages about $4.06 billion and $5.07B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Nautilus Inc Com (NYSE:NLS) by 31,777 shares to 1.02M shares, valued at $13.58M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Garmin Ltd Shs (NASDAQ:GRMN) by 9,409 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.62 million shares, and has risen its stake in Tripadvisor Inc (NASDAQ:TRIP).
